name: learning-game-studio
description: Makes teaching interactions genuinely playable: selects a game mechanic that fits the learning objective, gives it readable feedback and game feel, aligns rewards with mastery, and blocks mechanics that would teach something wrong.
author: Travis Chen
exampleQueries: 這一章的互動很單調，幫我選一個適合的遊戲機制並實作
把「移項法則」改造成有目標、有回饋、有進度的遊戲化關卡
答對答錯看起來一樣、按下去沒反應，幫我補回饋感
檢查我的教學互動有沒有因為遊戲機制而教錯或誤導學生
